subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 2: Team Talk – How often do you do sports?
outcomes: I can understand how often Arlo and Sultan do sports.
I can ask and answer with "How often do you …?"
I can use Really?, I don't believe it! and You're so funny!

tf.s: Arlo goes to school by scooter.
tf.why: Yes! Arlo gets to school by scooter.

tf.s: Sultan does more sports than Arlo.
Sultan does gymnastics once a week.
tf.why: Correct! Sultan does gymnastics once a week.
Right! He does karate every Monday.

tf.s: "I don't believe it!" shows that you are surprised.
tf.why: Yes, we say it when something surprises us.

tf.s: "You're so funny!" is a way to say you are sad.
tf.why: We say "You're so funny!" when something makes us laugh.

tf.s: "Twice a week" means one time every week.
tf.why: Twice a week means two times every week.

tf.s: We ask "How often do you …?" to find out how many times you do something.
tf.why: Great! How often asks about frequency.

tf.s: Sultan says "I don't believe it!" because Arlo does karate too.
tf.why: Yes, he is surprised that Arlo does karate too.
Every day means all the days of the week.

boxes.q: How does Arlo get to school?
How often does Sultan do gymnastics?
boxes.why: He does it once a week.
I don't believe it! shows surprise.

boxes.q: "I can stand on one leg and make a face." You say:
boxes.why: A funny action gets "You're so funny!"
We use Does with he, she or a name.

hunt.q: Sultan does it once a week.

mcq.why: Once a week tells us how often.

mcq.q: Which expression do you use when something makes you laugh?
mcq.why: We say "You're so funny!" when someone is funny.

mcq.q: Which frequency expression means "not many times"?
mcq.why: Not very often means only a few times.

mcq.q: What does "I'm learning to swim" mean?
o: I'm starting to swim and I'm not good at it yet.
mcq.why: Learning means you are still practising.

mcq.q: "I go swimming at 5.30 every morning." What can you say?

o: How often do you go swimming?
How often does you go swimming?
How often are you go swimming?
I play football twice a week.
I play football two a week.
I twice play football a week.

mcq.q: Why does Sultan say "I don't believe it!"?
o: He is surprised that Arlo does karate too.
mcq.why: He didn't expect Arlo to do karate too.

mcq.q: Ali swims every day. Sami swims once a week. Who swims more often?
mcq.why: Every day is more often than once a week.
